name: Financial Success
overview: Scripture teaches that financial success is ultimately empowered by the Lord, who grants the ability to gain wealth as part of His covenant faithfulness, as seen in Deuteronomy 8:18. Prosperity is linked to faithful obedience and meditation on God's Word, which leads to a prosperous and successful path (Joshua 1:8). Honoring God with one's resources and firstfruits is a key principle, and the blessing of the Lord brings genuine riches without sorrow (Proverbs 3:9; 10:22). True wealth is accompanied by righteousness and enduring blessing, reflecting God's provision and covenant promises (Psalms 112:3; Deuteronomy 28:11).
